name: Listening Post
author: Jeremy Longshore
description: Listening Post brings your Perception signal room into the Omarchy bar: ranked AI releases, pricing changes, incidents, engineering notes, and a five-item daily brief. Open its panel, pair with a device token from oma.intentsolutions.io/perception/. Your token stays out of process arguments and logs. It retains its last good field through outages and syncs read state to your account. Without a token, 29 curated HTTPS feeds remain available as a migration fallback. No article bodies or telemetry.

schema.label: Desktop notifications
schema.description: Notify on new model releases and unresolved status incidents. Engineering posts and changelog commits never notify.

schema.label: Rank by agents you use
schema.description: Reads the file names in the Agents plugin usage folder (read-only) so vendors you actually run float to the top of each lane.

schema.label: Perception API
schema.description: Canonical Perception API endpoint. Other origins fail closed.

schema.label: Perception credential file
schema.description: Managed by connect-perception.sh. Other paths fail closed so secrets never enter QML settings.
